name: web-recon
title: Web Initial Recon
description: The opening evidence sweep for an HTTP target: content discovery, nikto, and virtual-host fuzzing. Unlocks once nmap has proven an HTTP port. Each step runs through the same scope-enforced runner and parser as `obol run`.

steps.label: Content discovery
steps.note: Fuzz paths for the unlinked surface (admin panels, .git, backups, /api) — maps discovered content.

steps.label: Nikto scan
steps.note: Baseline server/app misconfiguration and interesting-file leads (candidates to verify, not confirmed vulns).

steps.label: Virtual-host discovery
steps.note: Subdomain/vhost fuzzing — noisier, and needs a known domain (set one with --set domain=example.com if nmap did not reveal it).
